The Incident of Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik Ashja'ee (RA) with a Jew and the Justice of Hadhrat Umar (RA) in this Matter

Hadhrat Suwayd bin Ghafala (RA) reports that when Hadhrat Umar (RA) once arrived in Shaam, a man belonging to the Ahlul Kitaab said to him, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! A man from amongst the Mu'mineen did this to me." The man's head was cut and he had been beaten. Hadhrat Umar (RA) became extremely angry and then said to Hadhrat Suhayb (RA), "Go and investigate who is responsible for this and then bring the culprit to me." Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) proceeded and discovered that the person responsible was Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik Ashja'ee (RA). Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) said to Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik (RA), "The Ameerul Mu'mineen is extremely angry with you. Bring along Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) to speak to him because I fear that he will be very hasty in deciding your matter."
After Hadhrat Umar (RA) had completed his salaah, he called for Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) and asked him whether he had brought the person. "Yes," replied Hadhrat Suhayb (RA). In the meanwhile, Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik (RA) had already approached Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) and narrated the incident to him. Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) then stood up and said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! The man is Awf bin Maalik (RA). Please give him a hearing and do not be hasty with him." (Turning to Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik (RA)) Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "What has happened between you and this person?" Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik (RA) said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! I saw this man pushing along the donkey of a Muslim woman. He then poked the donkey so that it should throw her off, but it did not. He then pushed the donkey and it dropped her. Thereafter, he fell on to her (and raped her. Unable to bear this, I then hit him)."
Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Bring the woman to me so that she may confirm what you said." When Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik (RA) went to her, her father and her husband said, "What do you want with our woman? You have already disgraced us (by relating the story)." However, the woman said, "By Allaah! I shall definitely go with him!" Her father and husband then said, "We shall rather go and relate the incident on your behalf." The two men then went to Hadhrat Umar (RA) and related the story just as Hadhrat Awf bin Maalik (RA) had. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then had the Jew crucified and said (to the Jewish
